payoutCycle.description: Traders can request their first payout after 8 calendar days from placing the first trade, with subsequent payouts available on an 8-day cycle.

warnings: Breaching maximum dynamic drawdown or daily loss limits leads to account termination.
Inactivity for extended periods or restricted trading strategies may affect payout eligibility.

faqs.question: How often can I request a payout with E8 Markets?
faqs.answer: E8 Markets allows traders to request their first payout after 8 calendar days from placing their first trade on the funded account. Subsequent payouts can also be requested on an 8-day cycle.

seo.title: E8 Markets Payout Schedule & Frequency
seo.metaDescription: Learn about E8 Markets payout cycle, including the initial 8-day waiting period and subsequent withdrawal rules.

faqs.question: What are the drawdown limits for E8 Markets accounts?
faqs.answer: E8 Markets features maximum drawdown limits based on account equity/balance rules along with daily loss limits. Exceeding these drawdown thresholds results in account breach.

seo.title: E8 Markets Drawdown Rules & Risk Management
seo.metaDescription: Understand E8 Markets maximum drawdown and daily loss limit rules to stay compliant during evaluation and trading.

faqs.question: What is the profit split ratio offered by E8 Markets?
faqs.answer: E8 Markets provides a default profit split of 80% to the trader. Through their account scaling plan, successful traders can scale up their profit split to 90%.

seo.title: E8 Markets Profit Split Percentage and Scaling
seo.metaDescription: Discover how E8 Markets profit splits work from the initial 80% split up to 90% via their scaling plan.

faqs.question: Which payout methods are supported by E8 Markets?
faqs.answer: Traders can request payouts via Rise, Cryptocurrency (such as USDT), and direct Bank Wire transfers. Processing typically occurs within 24 hours of approval.

seo.title: E8 Markets Withdrawal & Payout Methods
seo.metaDescription: Explore supported payout options at E8 Markets including Rise, Crypto, and Bank Wire transfers.

pros: Profit split starts at 80% and scales up to 90%
Multiple convenient withdrawal options including Crypto and Rise
cons: Dynamic drawdown limits require careful risk management
